text: Several studies have examined the relationship between parental bonding and alexithymia, using both clinical and healthy populations. For instance, a recent meta-analysis [ 24 ] showed that there is a negative association between maternal care and alexithymia and a positive association between maternal overprotection and alexithymia among student samples. Relationships between attachment styles and the capacity to represent affective states have also been observed among other non-clinical adult samples. Indeed, several studies have shown that insecure attachment is related to alexithymia [ 25 – 28 ] and that dismissive attachment, in particular, is linked to dysfunctional emotion regulation processing [ 29 , 30 ].
source_label: Attachment style and parental bonding: Relationships with fibromyalgia and alexithymia
